script_hooks.logic:
If condition flag "damaged_attack" is up this frame and the enemy has the NULL_PHYSICAL status, then choose state 21 next and stop.
If condition flag "ability_done_for_force_field" is up this frame, then choose state 22 next and stop.
If condition flag "ability_done_for_fiendish_rage" is up this frame, then
  Let v2 be call helper3.
  If v2, then v2 → unset-status-ailments with (the TARGET_BUDDY status).
  Stop.
Let v3 be call helper with (this state).
If the register's 'currBpIdx' is not v3, then choose state 13 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If call helper4, then the enemy uses the move labelled "fiendish_rage" with options {forceTargets: [call helper3]}.
  Otherwise
    Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
    If call helper5 with (this state), then
      For each x in ["blizzaga", "blizzaga_all", "absolute_zero"]
        Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled x on the enemy.
        Append ability2 to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    If call helper6 with (this state), then append (the id of the move labelled "force_field" on the enemy) to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    The enemy uses ability.
